newsitem.title: USA: Airnet Q1 $0.20 vs pro forma $0.16.
newsitem.headline: Airnet Q1 $0.20 vs pro forma $0.16.

text.p: Adjusted pro forma earnings per share (note C)

Note A -- Prior to the Company's initial public offering (the "Offering") on May 31, 1996, it operated as an S Corporation under the Internal Revenue Code for tax purposes and consequently, was not subject to federal and certain state income taxes.

Note B -- 1995 balances include pro forma adjustments incurred as a result of the Offering. Such adjustments are the result of restructured compensation plans, the elimination of a deferred compensation plan, the reduction of interest expense, the termination of a covenant not to compete and income taxed as if the company were a C Corporation for the quarter. All such changes were effective with the consummation of the Offering.
Note C -- Assumes the shares issued in the Offering were outstanding for the quarter ended December 31, 1995, for a pro forma balance of shares outstanding of 12,317,835.
